summary: The team is driving a China-focused SEO/AI visibility push for Asia Star and Intelligent China while finalizing the knowledge website redesign and managing a wave of content approvals and event promotions.
summaryDetail: The top priority is the global marketing strategy sync from June 30: Asia Star and Intelligent China are the two flagship programs for search/AI visibility, targeting top-5 ranking within seven months. Joseph needs to draft target areas, audience focus, and search prompts, and analyze Asia Star participant profiles and CRM hot leads; the team must also audit conversion tracking and launch the Intelligent China webpage. The knowledge website redesign is in final feedback mode: Joseph shares the HTML inspiration file, Julie and the team lead hold a 30-minute feedback session, and Joker makes design changes—keeping the two-menu structure and dispersing videos by topic. This week, urgent items include finalizing the Western MBA teacher training press release with Xueming, following up with Professor Li for greenlight on the translated Business Sentiment Index Q3 2026 report, and reviewing Manaferra's AI Search Campaign report to clarify tracked-prompt stats. Upcoming: the 2026 Women in Leadership Forum promotion is now officially kicked off; event agendas and posters need updating with Professor Xiaomeng's revised speech topic by November 15; and the Flow Design PPT/email to Zongchao waits until the new English homepage launches.

decisions.text: All devices must update to the new password to prevent further account lockouts.
Remove the standalone videos section and disperse videos by topic instead.
Keep the two-menu structure (Knowledge and School menus).
Do not add a stock-market ticker at the top of the homepage.
Bring the BCI banner into the knowledge section, alongside BSI and CKGSB indices.
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China as top two programs; put US partnerships on hold initially.
Consider Berkeley as a possible third priority among overseas programs, to be addressed in the audit phase.
Target top-5 ranking for China business school search visibility within seven months, with number one as a stretch goal.
Wait until the new English homepage is launched before sending the Flow Design PPT and email to Zongchao
